name: CMIP5 and CMIP6 multi-model ensemble simulations
access: The CMIP6 and CMIP5 data are available through the Earth System Grid Federation system (ESGF; https://esgf-node.llnl.gov/search/cmip6/, https://esgf-node.llnl.gov/search/cmip5/, respectively), and the models and ensemble members used in this study are listed in Table S1 and S2 in Supporting Information S1 and in Figure 1.
